sra_select_own_student.name: sra_select_own_student
sra_select_own_student.using: exists (select 1 from students s where s.id = "student_room_assignments"."student_id" and s.auth_user_id = auth.uid())

sra_select_linked_parent.name: sra_select_linked_parent
sra_select_linked_parent.using: exists (select 1 from "parent_student_relationships" psr where psr.student_id = "student_room_assignments"."student_id" and psr.parent_id = public.current_parent_id())

sra_all_hostel_admin.name: sra_all_hostel_admin
sra_all_hostel_admin.using: public.current_staff_role() = 'hostel_admin' and exists (select 1 from rooms r where r.id = "student_room_assignments"."room_id" and r.hostel_id = public.current_staff_hostel_id())
sra_all_hostel_admin.withCheck: public.current_staff_role() = 'hostel_admin' and exists (select 1 from rooms r where r.id = "student_room_assignments"."room_id" and r.hostel_id = public.current_staff_hostel_id())

lae_select_own_student.name: lae_select_own_student
lae_select_own_student.using: exists (select 1 from "leave_requests" lr where lr.id = "leave_approval_events"."leave_request_id" and lr.student_id = public.current_student_id())

lae_select_linked_parent.name: lae_select_linked_parent
lae_select_linked_parent.using: exists (select 1 from "leave_requests" lr join "parent_student_relationships" psr on psr.student_id = lr.student_id where lr.id = "leave_approval_events"."leave_request_id" and psr.parent_id = public.current_parent_id())

lae_insert_own_parent_response.name: lae_insert_own_parent_response
lae_insert_own_parent_response.withCheck:
"leave_approval_events"."actor_parent_id" = public.current_parent_id()
        and exists (
          select 1 from "leave_requests" lr
          join "parent_student_relationships" psr on psr.student_id = lr.student_id
          where lr.id = "leave_approval_events"."leave_request_id" and psr.parent_id = public.current_parent_id()
        )
        and ("leave_approval_events"."response" is null or "leave_approval_events"."biometric_confirmed" = true)
        and (
          "leave_approval_events"."response" is null
          or exists (
            select 1 from trusted_devices td
            where td.parent_id = public.current_parent_id() and td.revoked_at is null
          )
        )

lae_select_staff.name: lae_select_staff
lae_select_staff.using: exists (select 1 from staff s where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid())

lae_insert_reception_manual_override.name: lae_insert_reception_manual_override
lae_insert_reception_manual_override.withCheck:
"leave_approval_events"."event_type" = 'manual_override'
        and "leave_approval_events"."actor_staff_id" = public.current_staff_id()
        and exists (
          select 1 from "staff" s join "leave_requests" lr on true
          join "students" st on st.id = lr.student_id
          where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid() and lr.id = "leave_approval_events"."leave_request_id" and st.hostel_id = s.hostel_id
        )

leave_requests_select_linked_parent.name: leave_requests_select_linked_parent
leave_requests_select_linked_parent.using: exists (select 1 from "parent_student_relationships" psr where psr.student_id = "leave_requests"."student_id" and psr.parent_id = public.current_parent_id())

leave_requests_update_linked_parent.name: leave_requests_update_linked_parent
leave_requests_update_linked_parent.using: exists (select 1 from "parent_student_relationships" psr where psr.student_id = "leave_requests"."student_id" and psr.parent_id = public.current_parent_id())
leave_requests_update_linked_parent.withCheck: exists (select 1 from "parent_student_relationships" psr where psr.student_id = "leave_requests"."student_id" and psr.parent_id = public.current_parent_id())

leave_requests_all_reception.name: leave_requests_all_reception
leave_requests_all_reception.using: exists (select 1 from "staff" s join "students" st on st.hostel_id = s.hostel_id where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid() and s.role = 'reception_warden' and st.id = "leave_requests"."student_id")
leave_requests_all_reception.withCheck: exists (select 1 from "staff" s join "students" st on st.hostel_id = s.hostel_id where s.auth_user_id = auth.uid() and s.role = 'reception_warden' and st.id = "leave_requests"."student_id")

leave_requests_all_hostel_admin.withCheck: public.current_staff_role() = 'hostel_admin' and exists (select 1 from "students" st where st.id = "leave_requests"."student_id" and st.hostel_id = public.current_staff_hostel_id())

dae_select_own.name: dae_select_own

journey_events_insert_reception_library.name: journey_events_insert_reception_library
journey_events_insert_reception_library.withCheck:
(public.current_staff_role() = 'reception_warden' or public.current_staff_role() = 'library_incharge')
        and "journey_events"."verified_by_staff_id" = public.current_staff_id()
        and "journey_events"."biometric_confirmed" = true
